title: SmartAgri UGM Researchers Undergo DJI Agras Drone Operational Training to Strengthen UAV-Based Agricultural Capabilities
excerpt: SmartAgri UGM researchers participated in a hands-on operational training session for the DJI Agras agricultural drone, strengthening the team's technical competency in UAV-based precision spraying and field monitoring. The training supports SmartAgri's ongoing efforts to integrate drone technology into its smart farming research and field application programs.
